_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Farid Karimi
about_me: I'm Farid, a data scientist at Domino's HQ in Ann Arbor working on demand forecasting. I want to move into climate tech, especially grid or energy forecasting. I'd love to talk to anyone at a climate startup that needs forecasting.
goals: Move into a climate-tech data science role

debriefs.text: Mei Tanaka leads our forecasting team at Domino's. She said she'd be a reference and that she moved from energy forecasting herself.
Met Omar Haddad at Detroit Hardware Night. GridLeaf needs demand forecasting for their battery units and he's hiring after the seed round closes.
Talked to Priya Rao, partner at Northwind Climate Fund, on a panel. She said their portfolio always needs data people and she'd share their jobs board.
Prof. Farah Siddiqui from Public Health asked if I'd volunteer on their Detroit food-access study data. I said I'd look at it.
